# Marble: a faceted glass ball r 0.26 m with a pale swirl band round it (so its roll reads).
# Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Glass --base-color 0.3294 0.4745 0.6902 --no-slot
material new Swirl --base-color 0.8784 0.8275 0.7843 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Marble --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.26 --location 0 0 0
material assign Glass
mode edit
select face where "pos.x > -0.07 && pos.x < 0.07"
material assign Swirl
mode object
shade flat
export marble.glb
